ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation VAR+ Launcher - Security
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated use of Environment Variables to execute PowerShell Note: Unmapped fields: ServiceFileName

sequences.query: (event_id = 4697 AND (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*cmd.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\"set.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\-f.*")) AND (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\/c.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\/r.*")))
